purpose: spec §28: bind the unchanged acceptance semantics to Acceptance Generation 3

generation.evidence_substrate_schema: sealed-evidence-substrate:v1 + sealed-evidence-manifest:v1 (NEW: the evidence-bearing disk image is a sealed protocol object)

generation3_protocol_additions: supreme invariant: if the Agent can observe it, directly or through parsing/indexing, it must be frozen and hash-bound before admission
per-case evidence-bearing substrate images constructed and sealed at generation construction time (no generic validation images, no post-extraction injection)
SealedEvidenceManifestV1: the expected Agent-observable Evidence world (paths, sizes, hashes, canonical file: keys, extra-evidence policy)
logical Evidence-world digest over the parsed stores (files.db/events.db), reproducible provisioning required
execution gate extended: SUBSTRATE_IMAGE_HASH_MATCH, EVIDENCE_WORLD_DIGEST_MATCH, EXPECTED_EVIDENCE_KEYS_PRESENT, UNEXPECTED_SEMANTIC_EVIDENCE_ABSENT, PARSER_CONFIG_HASH_MATCH

unchanged_requirements.population_rule: each holdout case family >= 2/3 repetitions at CaseOutcomeV2 {success, success_with_limitations}; ALL families; no aggregate compensation
unchanged_requirements.six_axes: structural (zero tolerance), functional (truth floor), semantic, negative-case safety, reliability, availability — unchanged
unchanged_requirements.verdict_rule: ACCEPTED only if ALL six axes PASS
unchanged_requirements.independence_declaration: thresholds are NOT influenced by the Generation-1 or Generation-2 diagnostics (both B6_INVALID, DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY)

calibration_continuity.reason: production runtime, model configuration and calibration corpus unchanged; acceptance-infrastructure repairs do not invalidate calibration
